about: Three planted defects in the oracle, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: a lower bound compared the wrong way, an upper bound compared the wrong way, and a required step made optional going unnoticed.

mutations.find: gte: (a, b) => b < a, gt: (a, b) => b < a,
mutations.replace: gte: (a, b) => b > a, gt: (a, b) => b > a,

mutations.find: lte: (a, b) => b > a, lt: (a, b) => b > a,
mutations.replace: lte: (a, b) => b < a, lt: (a, b) => b < a,
